serverInfo.name: zenoa-mcp-server
serverInfo.title: Zenoa Sovereign Messenger & Developer MCP Server
serverInfo.description: Model Context Protocol server for Zenoa: sovereign private messenger, zero-cloud retention messaging, WebCrypto key exchange, Bot API dispatches, and OAuth 2.0 integration.

tools.name: send_secure_message
tools.description: Send an end-to-end encrypted or ephemeral message via sovereign 0ms TTL relay.

recipient.description: Recipient username or Zenoa sovereign ID

ttlMs.description: Time-to-live in milliseconds (default 0 for ephemeral 0ms relay)

tools.name: get_system_status
tools.description: Check the health, active relays, and zero-retention status of the Zenoa network.

tools.name: verify_zenoa_identity
tools.description: Cryptographically verify a @zenoa sovereign username and public identity key.

tools.name: get_api_catalog
tools.description: Retrieve RFC 9727 API catalog entries and machine-readable service descriptions.
